signature.name: VTask.coprodMap
signature.type: {ι : Type u_1} -> {R : Type u_3} -> {M : ι → Type u_5} -> {N : Type u_6} -> [Semiring R] -> [(i : ι) → AddCommMonoid (M i)] -> [(i : ι) → Module R (M i)] -> [AddCommMonoid N] -> [Module R N] -> [DecidableEq ι] -> (f : (i : ι) → M i →ₗ[R] N) -> (Π₀ (i : ι), M i) →ₗ[R] N

conventions.note: NONE_DECLARED: VTask.coprodMap is a total construction whose behavior on all inputs, including degenerate cases like empty index types or zero elements, is fully determined by linearity and the universal property with no junk-value conventions needed.

facts.statement: ∀ {ι : Type} {R : Type} {M : ι → Type} {N : Type} [Semiring R] [(i : ι) → AddCommMonoid (M i)] [(i : ι) → Module R (M i)] [AddCommMonoid N] [Module R N] [DecidableEq ι] (f : (i : ι) → M i →ₗ[R] N) (i : ι) (m : M i), VTask.coprodMap f (DFinsupp.single i m) = f i m
